Intro: Marşalla xülda, I suppose this is a place to exchange food? Oh! Please forgive my lack of manners.
I come from Moġara, east of Aldok. I was meaning to find an Aijinkovan cook out west, but that cursed tyrant pushed me here in this dreaded city…
I have my doubts about any respectable chef living in a warzone, but a local tipped me to your place. I like how you decorated the place! Anyways…
I heard you acquired a Moġaran recipe book. Can you prepare a [DISH] for me? A cook such as yourself should have no trouble. I am certain of it!
Success: The touch, the garnish, the aroma is… acceptable. Yes, this is as close as the real deal! I give you my gratitude, young cook. See you soon.
Fail: Oh dear… I am sorry. I may have expected too much for a street cook. I simply do not recognize what is in front of me. I must leave, if I may.
